verdict.rationale: Docusign documents a public eSignature REST API on its Developer Center, ships an official Node.js client library, and publishes OpenAPI/Swagger specifications on GitHub that it says let 'both humans and computers' discover the service's capabilities. Independent developers report building production integrations quickly and call the documentation thorough, though one report describes an embedded-flow problem that required moving to a legacy API version. Missing for 10: the OpenAPI spec is not served from the developer portal (probes of the standard paths returned 404), and hands-on reports on API maturity are mixed.
